name: Mushroom
summary: The mirror of silver: dilutes red pigment only, and only with two copies, walking a chestnut's red body toward a flat sepia. A black or bay horse carries it almost invisibly, having little red to lose.

phenotypes.name: Mushroom carrier
phenotypes.description: One copy shows nothing. The allele passes on invisibly - two carriers bred together are how mushroom appears.

phenotypes.name: Mushroom
phenotypes.description: Red pigment cut hard and partly traded for black, so a chestnut becomes a flat sepia-khaki. A black or bay horse has little red to lose and looks much the same.
